issues.claim: In the .NET 10 SDK the audit runs during `dotnet restore` and by default checks transitive packages too (`NuGetAuditMode` = `all`).
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt of the auditing-packages page does not show the NuGetAuditMode default. As I remember it, the default `all` applies to projects targeting net10.0 or later, and older target frameworks default to `direct`. The SDK version alone is probably not the condition. The statement is also at odds with the generator's own note, which says the default changed with the .NET 9 SDK. A candidate could learn the wrong rule.
issues.suggestedFix: Re-check the NuGetAuditMode default on the auditing-packages page. If it depends on the target framework, write: "for projects targeting net10.0 and later the default `NuGetAuditMode` is `all`, so transitive packages are audited; for older target frameworks set `<NuGetAuditMode>all</NuGetAuditMode>` explicitly." Make the same change in the RU text. This also fits the CI-gate step, which already sets `NuGetAuditMode` to `all`.
